_meta.method: For each contract, the Qur'an-stage and tafsir rows of its shipped *_v4 lineage file were cross-referenced against the verse lists in quran_word_filter_map.json. A link is recorded ONLY where a lineage-cited verse appears in that Q word's verse list. Same-verse overlaps that do not represent derivation (e.g. 2:275 sits in both riba and bay' lists) are EXCLUDED and documented below.
_meta.assurance_scale: established = contract named/directly grounded in the word's verses; plausible = juristic derivation, not named in the Qur'an (noted per link); illustrative = same-verse context, supportive not originating.
excluded_overlaps: C01-Q11 (4:12 shared with inheritance list — co-ownership context, not origin)
C02-Q10 (73:20 shared with qard list — artifact)
C03-Q01 (2:275 riba half of the verse — contrast, not origin)
C03-Q06 (4:29 wrongful-consumption half — covered by Q14)
C10-Q09 (57:18 shared charity/loan verse — origin stays with Q10)
gaps: No contract is left without a Q link, but two are derivations not namings: C02 (mudarabah) and C06 (istisna) — flagged plausible, never upgrade without scholar sign-off.
